# Test that runtime/cgo uses pure-Go files under GOEXPERIMENT=runtimecgopurego
# even when -msan or -fsanitize=thread is enabled, and falls back to C files
# only when GOEXPERIMENT=noruntimecgopurego is set.

env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=runtimecgopurego
env CC=
env CGO_CPPFLAGS=
env CGO_CFLAGS=

# Default: pure-Go runtime/cgo (no C files).
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout '^\[\]$'

# CGO_CFLAGS=-fsanitize=thread still uses pure-Go runtime/cgo.
env CGO_CFLAGS=-fsanitize=thread
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout '^\[\]$'

# -msan still uses pure-Go runtime/cgo (and includes cgo_msan.go).
env CGO_CFLAGS=
go list -msan -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout '^\[\]$'
go list -msan -f '{{.GoFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout 'cgo_msan\.go'

# GOEXPERIMENT=noruntimecgopurego uses C runtime/cgo files.
env GOEXPERIMENT=noruntimecgopurego
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout 'gcc_libinit_unix.c'

-- go.mod --
module m

-- p.go --
package p
